triage.fix_rationale: The waits and timeouts (LOBBY_TIMEOUT, per-test timeout) live in the e2e specs, the lobby helper and the Playwright config, so raising them or trimming the work done inside them is the fix. If longer limits still fail, check whether the dependabot bump broke the renderer.
triage.hypothesis: The aubade lobby did not finish loading within the fixed 20s wait (and the 30s test timeout) on the CI runner. The "Unlocking the lobby" text stayed visible, so most aubade and a11y tests timed out. The likely cause is slow software-rendered WebGL on a headless runner. The lift test's aria-label mismatch is probably the same slowness.
